methods.notes: Scales generally advertise briefly in Bluetooth mode after a weigh-in; WBS13 setup advertisements also follow a button hold. FD77 model/flag parsing is declared in protocol_details.advertising. Installed + sync-requested is the weigh-in trigger. Do not assume an idle scale in Wi-Fi mode advertises.

identification.notes: Names are candidate filters only; select WBS13 versus WBS12 from the model-specific advertisement data in protocol_details.advertising. WBS12 reports only FD77 service data plus a Body Comp xx name. The new WITHINGS GATT service is shared with other products and is deliberately NOT an identification UUID. Do not match WBS12 by that service alone.

device.name: Withings Body Smart (WBS13) and Body Comp (WBS12) — local BLE
device.notes:
ONLY WBS13 Body Smart (WPP model 0x10) and WBS12 Body Comp (WPP model 0x12) are in scope. WBS06 uses incoming Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM and has its own spec. WBS05, WBS05S, watches and other Withings products are not covered by shared marketing names or by the newer WITHINGS GATT layout.
The two variants share WPP framing, mutual authentication and stored- measurement reads, but NOT discovery, GATT UUIDs or end-of-sync behavior. Select the profile from the advertisement/model before connecting, then require its exact WPP characteristic. Do not probe one profile's writes against the other. WBS13 sends SYNC_OK; WBS12 never sends or echoes it.
This is a READ-ONLY measurement session after authentication. There are no delete, association-key, roster/user, unit, Wi-Fi, clock, setup or firmware writes. The only other writes are protocol housekeeping: PROBE/challenge replies, WBS13-only SYNC_OK and DISCONNECT. Existing health records remain on the scale for its owner/other clients; a phone app reaching the scale first can remove them through its own separate session, which is outside this spec.
The 32-character per-association `kl` is required. It can be pasted from an existing owner export or retrieved once from the owner's account; subsequent measurement reads are local. `kl` is distinct from the probe reply's factory/session secret and from TLS identity material.
Consumer integration is identify_only because this project ships no dedicated mutual-auth/WPP/session/deduplication handler. The WPP request bytes are implementation facts for that handler, not generic one-shot GATT commands. Supported status requires strict peer verification, variant routing, non-destructive lifecycle and private measurement storage.

openness.notes: No vendor protocol specification is published. Facts come from the MIT-licensed withings-local v0.5.0 source and its protocol notes at 52cfaa1f9157972373d34ce3021dbcd481c2f907. Body Comp evidence is one community hardware report; Body Smart has the author's hardware evidence. Neither is hardware verification by this project.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: WBS13 uses a three-second underside-button hold; WBS12 uses a short press. The scale displays six digits.

procedures.basis: withings-local README pairing instructions at the pinned revision; not run by this project.
procedures.indicator: A six-digit pairing code appears on the scale, with about 30 seconds reported to enter it.
procedures.name: Body Smart WBS13 pairing

steps.action: Hold the underside button for about three seconds, start pairing on the host and enter the six-digit code shown on the scale.
steps.expect: The host reports a stored BLE bond.

procedures.basis: withings-local README and the single community WBS12 hardware report at the pinned revision; not run by this project.
procedures.indicator: A six-digit code appears after the short press; subscribing before pairing can hang.
procedures.name: Body Comp WBS12 pairing

steps.action: Briefly press the underside button, start pairing with a KeyboardDisplay-capable host agent and enter the six-digit code.
steps.expect: The host reports a stored BLE bond; a later Setup failed display alone does not refute it.

exclusivity.recovery: Keep the local adapter close, disconnect other readers and re-pair if the bond was lost after a battery event. Do not use a BLE proxy as a substitute for a bond held by the authenticating host.

pairing.notes: BLE bonding and WPP mutual authentication are separate gates. A bond or an accepted GATT write is not proof that the peer knows kl.

unpair.notes: Remove only the replacement host's BLE bond to withdraw that host. This spec does not erase the scale's LE keys or association; full owner reset is a separate physical operation.

credentials.notes: The scale never reveals kl in a probe. Never commit kl, account passwords, Bluetooth addresses, user IDs, roster names or health measurements. Fixtures use placeholders only.
stored_on_device: Existing association key material and roster/settings (not modified by this spec)

factory_reset.description: Reset is not needed to change local readers and is not a remedy for a missing kl. Do not choose it merely to troubleshoot pairing.
factory_reset.effect: The on-scale Reset entry wipes setup. Expect the BLE bond/association and kl-backed local access to need restoration; whether stored measurements survive is not established.

procedures.basis: withings-local README at 52cfaa1f9157972373d34ce3021dbcd481c2f907: a short press opens the on-scale menu and its Reset entry wipes the scale's setup; not run by this project.
procedures.indicator: The scale returns to setup/onboarding; the precise screen sequence and record retention were not recorded.
procedures.name: On-scale Reset menu

steps.action: Briefly press the underside button to open the on-scale menu, then deliberately choose Reset only after preserving the owner's association data and accepting setup loss.
steps.expect: Setup is wiped; complete owner association and restore the existing kl before attempting local reads.

methods.description: Offline key route for an already associated scale; the vendor app is used only to select Bluetooth mode, never by this client to change Wi-Fi.
methods.name: Use an existing kl and model-specific BLE pairing

steps.action: In the vendor app open Wi-Fi configuration, hold the scale's underside button for about three seconds, and choose the no-Wi-Fi/Bluetooth-only option.
steps.expect: The scale is in Bluetooth mode. Avoid the on-scale Reset entry, which wipes setup.

steps.action: Provide the scale's existing 32-character kl through a secret store and select WBS13 or WBS12 from its advertisement/model data.
For WBS13 hold the underside button for three seconds; for WBS12 briefly press it. Start BLE pairing and enter the six-digit code shown on the scale.
steps.expect: The host stores a BLE bond. A subsequent Setup failed display can still accompany a valid bond; verify through an authenticated read, not the display alone.

steps.action: Subscribe only to the selected variant's WPP characteristic and run the strict mutual-auth/read lifecycle in protocol_details.wpp.read_only_session.
steps.expect: Both SHA-1 proofs verify before battery, stored state or stored records are accepted.

cloud.local_alternative: The primary ble_direct method: paste an existing kl and complete local BLE pairing; subsequent measurement reads need no cloud session.
cloud.notes: Use only the owner's account. This spec does not declare the account API, store the account password, create a roster or self-key a reset scale.

methods.description: Optional online owner-account lookup when no kl export exists; not a per-measurement cloud dependency.
methods.name: Retrieve the owner's existing kl once

steps.action: Use the public integration's owner-login helper or account export to retrieve the existing scale's kl, then store only that 32-character key in a secret store.
steps.expect: The owner has the existing 32-character kl; no real key is written to this repository.

steps.action: Continue with the offline pairing/read route above.

setup.notes: High confidence reflects a working public implementation, not a replay by this project. The owner must have an existing 32-character kl, switch the scale to Bluetooth mode through the vendor app, and complete model- specific six-digit BLE pairing. No Wi-Fi credentials are sent by this spec. A pasted kl avoids the optional online account lookup.

rejoin.notes: Changing local readers does not require reset. Reuse the existing kl and pair the new host. Battery loss can invalidate pairing and require re-pairing/key restoration.

steps.action: Keep the existing kl in the owner's secret store, close other Bluetooth readers and pair the replacement host for the correct model.
If Wi-Fi mode is wanted again, use the vendor app's Wi-Fi configuration; this spec sends no Wi-Fi command. Bluetooth mode is required for the documented weigh-in advertisements.

testing.notes: This project did not contact a scale, open an account or use an owner key, Bluetooth address or health measurement. withings-local's source review reports one Body Smart and one community Body Comp, not broad firmware coverage. Synthetic SHA-1/WPP/measurement tests below are independent offline checks only.

variants.notes: Body Smart, WPP model 0x10. The WITH service's fourth UUID group is 0010 and its WPP characteristic is 00000024-5749-5448-0010-000000000000. SYNC_OK is enabled after a complete read and echoed when received as a device request.

Body Comp, WPP model 0x12, identified by FD77 service data and a Body Comp name, not by the WBS13 WITH service. GATT service 00000000-0000-5749-5448-494e47530000 and WPP characteristic 00000004-0000-5749-5448-494e47530000. No SYNC_OK.

evidence.documentation_review: The retained 100-page FCC exhibit for Withings Body Comp and Body Smart passed local PDF inspection in the source research. The separate vendor- hosted Body Smart guide also resolved as a PDF during this spec pass. Neither manual is evidence for WPP bytes.
evidence.hardware_reports: The author reports Body Smart WBS13 firmware 1311 locally. One community report covers Body Comp WBS12 firmware 1311/bootloader 2 with BlueZ. These are attributed upstream observations, not testing by this project and not a family-wide firmware allowlist. WBS12 reconnects without SYNC_OK in that report; that does not generalize SYNC_OK to other models.
open_questions: More WBS12 units/firmware and exact behavior of unknown measurement types/TLVs.
Whether WBS13 paired operation can coexist with Wi-Fi mode across firmware; this spec requires the reported Bluetooth-mode path.
Pairing/bond retention after battery events and exact factory-reset record retention.
evidence.public_implementation: withings-local v0.5.0 at 52cfaa1f9157972373d34ce3021dbcd481c2f907 supplied the WPP codec, mutual SHA-1 proofs, model profiles, non-deleting session, measurement parser, per-user/time/type deduplication and host setup. Its own tests include fragmented/back-to-back messages, strict metadata, exponent scaling and proof verification. No upstream code is imported by this spec's independent test.

initialization.description: Dedicated variant handler: subscribe to the exact WPP characteristic, send PROBE, require and answer the scale's 16-byte challenge, verify the scale's answer to our fresh 16-byte challenge, and only then issue read-only requests.
initialization.notes: A setup-mode PROBE_REPLY without a challenge is not an authenticated normal-mode session and must not be used for stored reads.

fd77.flags: Type 1, one byte: bit0 installed, bit1 sync requested, bit2 wake-up. Connect for measurement sync only when installed and sync requested are both set.
fd77.header: First u16 BE: protocol version in the high nibble, model in the low 12 bits (0x1012 = version 1, model 0x012).
fd77.other_fields: Type 2 carries six address bytes in unassociated setup advertisements; type 3 carries a short identity hash. Do not publish either.
fd77.sanitized_example: 10 12 11 03 34 01 02 03 04 = model 0x12, installed + sync requested, four-byte type-3 value. The example bytes are invented.
fd77.tlv: Each following header byte packs type in the high nibble and value length in the low nibble. Reject truncated fields instead of slicing beyond the advertisement.

with_uuid.grammar: 000000SS-5749-5448-MMMM-<12 hex digits>; MMMM is the WPP model, 0010 for Body Smart. A zero tail in setup mode is not a device address.

protocol_details.entity_coverage: No generic entities are declared. A WPP characteristic is a stateful authenticated byte stream, not a fixed-offset notification format. A dedicated handler should publish only known measure_types with their declared units, plus UTC weigh-in time and battery, after deduplication. Unknown types remain private raw diagnostics, not guessed sensors.

prohibited_writes.destructive: STORED_MEASURE action=2/delete-all and every record deletion.
prohibited_writes.firmware: Every firmware update command and every replacement-firmware/replacement-service path.
prohibited_writes.network_and_clock: All Wi-Fi mode/credential commands and TIME_SET 1281.
prohibited_writes.onboarding: ASSOCIATION_KEYS_SET 308, SCALE_SESSION/roster 269, SETUP_OK 275, user/unit 274 and local self-keying.
prohibited_writes.sync_ok: Prohibited on WBS12; supported only on WBS13 as declared above.

framing.device_request: Command bit 0x4000 marks a device-initiated request; base_command = command & ~0x4000. Do not confuse it with a response.
framing.list_end: A multi-message stored-measurement list ends with TLV type 256, length zero. Do not wait for a fixed record count.
framing.message: 01 | command:u16 BE | payload_length:u16 BE | payload; payload is zero or more TLVs.
framing.reassembly: Notifications and RFCOMM reads are fragments. Buffer across fragments using payload_length and emit back-to-back complete messages independently.
framing.string_or_bytes: Inside a TLV, variable strings/byte arrays have a one-byte length prefix followed by exactly that many bytes.
framing.tlv: type:u16 BE | length:u16 BE | value. Require exact message and TLV bounds; no trailing partial objects.

client_steps: Require the scale challenge to be exactly 16 bytes and preserve the exact MAC string.
Generate a cryptographically fresh, independent 16-byte client challenge.

Send command 296 with PROBE_CHALLENGE_RESPONSE {one-byte length 20 || SHA1(device_challenge || exact_mac || kl)} followed by PROBE_CHALLENGE {length-prefixed exact_mac || length-prefixed client_challenge}.
Require the scale's command-257 response to carry its 20-byte proof and compare in constant time with SHA1(client_challenge || exact_mac || kl).
If either proof is absent, malformed or mismatched, send no battery, stored-state or stored-record request and send no SYNC_OK. Close with DISCONNECT where the session permits.
mutual_authentication.secret: kl is exactly 32 ASCII characters. The MAC input is the exact advertised/challenge string as received, including case and separators; do not uppercase, lowercase, strip or normalize it.

probe.challenge_reply: Normal mode answers command 296 with PROBE_CHALLENGE {length-prefixed exact MAC string, length-prefixed 16-byte challenge}. Setup mode instead answers PROBE with PROBE_REPLY; do not read the store in that unauthenticated state.
probe.errors: ERROR carries CMD_ERROR {command:u16 BE, error:int32 BE}. Handle -2 busy, -3 unsupported, -4 rejected, -5 not authenticated, -8 invalid arguments and -9 arguments not set explicitly; never retry a write automatically.
probe.request: PROBE with APP_PROBE {os:u8=1, app:u8=1, version:u32 BE} and APP_PROBE_OS_VERSION {value:u16 BE=34}. Use app version 202609240 for the BLE profile.

deduplication.attributed_user: First nonzero ID in the valid user_ids, or 0 for guest/unknown (empty or all-zero valid IDs). Retain user_ids and attrib for display/attribution; uid is not required as a stable identity key.
deduplication.cross_sync_rule: Suppress already published samples per user/time/type across syncs. Every sync returns the whole store, so do not republish old records, but a different attributed user or guest at the same time and type is a new sample and must survive.
deduplication.regression: multi_user_regression below preserves invented Bob 90 kg, guest 55 kg and Alice 65 kg at one timestamp with their attribution.
deduplication.unknown_users: attributed_user 0 is its own guest/unknown group at each timestamp, distinct from every named user. Do not collapse all people into one timestamp/type bucket or use uid to merge them.
deduplication.within_group: Deduplicate measurement types within each (time, attributed_user) group. A later complete record of the same type replaces the earlier one, but never replaces another user, guest or a different type.

226.name: basal_metabolic_rate
226.notes: Unit spelling from the public implementation; not converted to kcal/day.

77.name: hydration
77.notes: Body water mass, not a percentage.

ordered_operations: Subscribe and PROBE; complete and strictly verify mutual authentication.
BATTERY_PERCENT (261, empty payload); reply object 263 is uint16 BE percent. A failed battery read retains the previous valid value and never becomes zero.
CONNECT_REASON (273, empty payload); object 280 is uint16 BE: 1 button, 2 weigh-in. Treat 2 as the normal measurement trigger; other reasons are not proof of new records.

STORED_MEASURE (271), object 276 value {action:u8=0, rc:int8=0}: read state. Object 277 is {count:int16 BE, oldest_time:int32 BE, wifi_configured:int8 BE}; oldest_time is a signed Unix-seconds field, not a duration.
If count > 0, send the same command with action=1 to read ALL records. Collect across messages through NULL TLV 256. Action=2 (delete) is prohibited.
WBS13 only: send SYNC_OK (277, empty payload) after the complete successful read and await its reply; also echo a device-initiated SYNC_OK as command 0x4115. WBS12: never send or echo SYNC_OK.
Send DISCONNECT (272, empty payload) without waiting for an answer, then close. Never issue association 308, roster/session 269, units 274, setup 275, clock 1281, Wi-Fi or firmware commands.

stored_data.extras: META_EXTEND 299, position/algorithm parameters and unknown objects attach to the current record where documented; otherwise preserve their type/raw value without inventing a measurement.
stored_data.layout: value:int32 BE | type:u16 BE | exponent:int16 BE (exactly 8 bytes).
stored_data.scaling: Decimal mathematical value = value * 10^exponent. Preserve decimal precision and the raw triple. Example 72345e-3 = 72.345 kg for type 1; 215e-1 = 21.5% for type 6.

stored_meta.layout: uid:u32 BE | valid:u8 | slot_count:u8 | user_ids[slot_count]:u32 BE each | attrib:u8 | time:u32 BE.
stored_meta.semantics: time is UTC Unix seconds and applies to following DATA objects. Only the first `valid` user IDs are meaningful; unused slots can contain junk. Reject truncated/trailing metadata. A bad META drops its following values rather than attaching them to the previous user/group.

read_only_session.unknown_types: Preserve {raw_value, type, exponent} without a unit or friendly name. WBS12 has reported unresolved types 177, 178, 189, 201, 202, 203 and 207 and TLV 2451; do not label them impedance by guesswork.

multi_user_regression.cross_sync_rule: First publication emits all three; an identical reread emits none. Bob, guest and Alice retain separate (time, attributed_user) groups despite sharing timestamp and type.
multi_user_regression.provenance: Entirely invented people and measurements; repeated uid demonstrates uid is not the group identity key.

test_vectors.provenance: Synthetic placeholder MAC aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff, invented 32-character kl and challenges, and invented measurements. No real association, address, roster or health data.

remaining_unknowns: WBS12 coverage beyond one community scale and the meaning of its unresolved measurement types and TLV 2451.
Exact firmware matrix for both models; firmware 1311 is an observed version, not a minimum or allowlist.
Whether every WBS13 firmware accepts the reported non-deleting SYNC_OK behavior; never copy it to WBS12.
Factory-reset retention of stored measurements and every battery-loss re-pairing case.
Local provisioning of a factory-reset scale without an existing association/roster is unsolved and deliberately excluded.
Other Withings models, including WBS06 Classic, WBS05/WBS05S and watches, require their own evidence and transports.

characteristics.name: WBS13 WPP request/response
characteristics.notes: Write WPP requests with response and reassemble notifications using the five-byte WPP header length. Observed ATT MTU 185 is not a protocol constant. No fixed command block: this is a stateful authenticated session.

services.name: Body Smart WBS13 WITH service (model 0x10)
services.notes: The final UUID group can carry unit-specific data in advertisements; the exact zeroed service shown here is the GATT layout from the author's Body Smart. Model selection uses the fourth group 0010.

characteristics.name: WBS12 WPP request/response
characteristics.notes: WPP over the newer GATT layout. Pairing can begin when notifications are enabled. No SYNC_OK at completion or in response to a device request.

services.name: Body Comp WBS12 WITHINGS service
services.notes: Shared Withings layout, not product identity. Only characteristic 00000004 was established for WPP; do not probe sibling characteristics as substitutes.
